scope: First real persistent Wan-Animate-2 two-window GPU smoke
summary: The model loaded on physical A800 GPUs 1 and 4, but the first inference reused an ABI-stale Triton launcher and failed before producing a video.
evidence: Batch events record a successful two-GPU mapping and 118.7508-second model load.
The inference log records torch._inductor.exc.InductorError with PY_SSIZE_T_CLEAN during cached binary loading.
lessons: Torch/Triton compiled artifacts must be keyed by source, Python, torch, CUDA, GPU architecture, and video shape instead of inheriting an unversioned user cache.
limitations: This attempt contains model-load timing but no generation throughput or visual-quality evidence.
next_actions: Use an explicit versioned Triton/Inductor cache and rerun in a fresh experiment directory.
